info.title: Flwn Data Engine: Domain API
info.description: Domain CRUD routes of flwn-data-engine (memory/MCP routes excluded). Generated from the running code on branch feature/schema-and-basic-cruds.

post.description: Global login account; exists without any organization. The email is stored lowercased.

get.description: Exact match on the lowercased email. Returns a page with 0 or 1 items.
The user's Member rows across all organizations.

post.summary: Create an organization with its first member
post.description: One transaction: the organization plus the creator's HUMAN member (role from creatorMember, default OWNER). An unknown createdById returns 422 INVALID_REFERENCE and nothing is saved. No X-Organization-Id needed.

delete.description: Archives (sets archivedAt); it does not remove the row.

post.description: HUMAN needs userId (no name/email); AI needs name (no userId).
